thread:
Elena (CEO): Morning team — short exec sync. Two quick asks: 1) final check on Private GA checklist, 2) confirm Dedicated autoscale rollout window. High level scorecard below.

Elena (CEO): Priorities for next 7 days: shipping Private (VPC) GA docs + deploy playbook, Dedicated autoscale enable by canary, and a perf/cost dashboard for top 10 customers.

Priya (VP Product): On Private GA: docs are in final review, security checklist done, legal needs one policy tweak (data residency clause). Docs link: https://confluence/redwood/private-ga-draft 

Marco (VP Eng): Autoscale canary is ready; rolling to 3 DCs tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We expect 5–10% latency variance during warmup. Canary config: `autoscale.v2 = true` with burst-policy.

Dana (CFO): Heads up on pricing: if autoscale reduces waste by our estimate (~18% infra cost drop for dedicated customers) we can propose adjusted committed tiers next quarter. Need validated numbers by next Wed.

Raj (Head of Sales): Sales flagged two large prospects wanting VPC in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 with SLA language. If GA date holds, we can push both deals to close this quarter.

Elena (CEO): Good. Ops recap from last incident — short note: we had a partial KV cache invalidation in us-east-1 on Friday that increased p95 by ~220ms for ~18 minutes. Root cause: race in cache invalidation during a failed rolling update.

Marco (VP Eng): Confirmed. Rollback and extra tracing helped; we pushed a fix to the rollout controller (RFC merged). No customer data exposure.

OpsBot: incident-1793960001 created by eng-oncall — severity: P2, duration: 18m, impacted: 4% of traffic in us-east-1, mitigation: rollback + restart, follow-up ticket: ENG-4279.

Dana (CFO): Impact on revenue: negligible for the week but we should track longer-term reliability metrics. Please add incident cost estimate to the ENG-4279 ticket.

Priya (VP Product): Quick metric snapshot (week-over-week): API calls +14%, token consumption +11%, hosted average latency p95 = 340ms (down from 360ms), Dedicated utilization average = 73% (target 70–80). Model switch fallback triggered 6 times.

Elena (CEO): Nice progress on latency. Action items: Marco — validate autoscale canary SLA guardrails and add extra telemetry for the first 48h; Priya — finalize GA docs and the security checklist item with legal; Dana — run cost sensitivity with autoscale numbers and share delta; Raj — prep messaging for pipeline deals and timeline.

Marco (VP Eng): On it. I'll post canary runbook and telemetry dashboard link once live.

Priya (VP Product): Legal sync scheduled for today 4pm PT. I'll update the GA page after.

Dana (CFO): I'll model two scenarios (18% cost reduction optimistic, 10% conservative) and drop numbers in this thread by Tue EOD.

Raj (Head of Sales): I'll share draft customer communication and timeline by EOD so AE teams can start outreach.

Elena (CEO): Final note — hiring: interview loop for SRE manager next week; want EVP signoff on comp band. Also, heads-up for all: company town hall next Friday, I'll share a short slide on GA and reliability metrics.

Priya (VP Product): :thumbsup:

Marco (VP Eng): :rocket: will coordinate with eng-oncall to ensure handoff during canary window.

Dana (CFO): :nerd_face: added ENG-4279 to finance watchlist.

Raj (Head of Sales): :raised_hands: good runway for closing.

Elena (CEO): Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping me directly. Short update in this thread by Thursday noon — otherwise we'll assume go for the canary.
